field_principles.status: Records the terminal Exp6542 intake state.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Names whether the content-pinned fixture is complete, partial, blocked, or disqualified.
field_principles.verdict_class: Separates complete data contracts from bounded, blocked, or disqualified paths.
field_principles.upstream_gate_receipt: Records the Exp6541 gate value, artifact hash, source commit, tools, resources, fixture bound, and protected hashes.
field_principles.source_revision_and_license_receipt: Binds the source checkout to the expected revision, license, schema, Z3 code, and problem count.
field_principles.source_tree_and_file_hashes: Records tree, required-file, prompt, schema, and source problem hashes before transformation.
field_principles.upstream_corruption_boundary: Shows that corrupted SQLite databases and paper aggregates are not inherited.
field_principles.intake_commitment: Freezes the bounded sample before replay labels or solver costs are inspected.
field_principles.family_turn_and_effort_census: Shows the selected fixture covers domains, sizes, turns, splits, and effort strata.
field_principles.source_to_local_identity_rows: Maps immutable source IDs to separate local unit IDs by hash.
field_principles.exact_replay_rows: Records local Z3 satisfiability, assignment validity, effort, timeout, and terminal status.
field_principles.solver_receipts: Binds solver version, replay code hash, call counts, and timeout policy.
field_principles.split_commitment: Seals base-problem lineage so no turn crosses train, development, or held splits.
field_principles.shard_manifest: Records content-addressed shards, journal, resume state, corrupt-resume probe, and final atomic replace.
field_principles.planned_and_terminal_unit_counts: Proves every planned unit has a terminal row before readiness opens.
field_principles.fixture_path_and_hash: Binds the final JSONL path, hash, row count, and round-trip check.
field_principles.leakage_attack_matrix: Records duplicate, chronology, family, name, order, hash, solver, resume, terminal, and aggregate attacks.
field_principles.external_constraint_corpus_ready_score: Opens only when source, replay, lineage, shards, attacks, hashes, terminal rows, and round-trip pass.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Names failed checks with expected and observed values.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Flattens identity, replay, shard, attack, and gate evidence.
field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Recomputes readiness and aggregate counts from local rows.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records date, paths, resources, git state, solver versions, and protected hashes.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Shows guarded inputs and conductor files were not modified by the run.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares content-pinned source intake and local Z3 replay with no LLM inference.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: True only for exact labels and assignment validity replayed by Z3.
field_principles.field_provenance: Maps fields to specs, rows, source files, transaction receipts, tests, or hashes.
field_principles.random_seed: Pins deterministic sample ordering and local IDs.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Detects drift in rows, gates, hashes, commands, and verdicts.
